findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: The person in charge (PIC) at today’s inspection had a Certified Food Protection Manager Certificate (CFPM) which had expired in February 2025. The CFPM exam must be retaken every 5 years. Ensure all CFPM certificates are maintained up to date, and available by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM. [C]

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting.
findings.comment: The PIC could not produce Employee Health Reporting Agreements during today’s inspection. All employees in facilities that handle food must read and sign an Employee Health Reporting Agreement within 30 days of hire. Inspector provided blank agreement for the PIC to make copies. Ensure agreements are signed by staff to be made available for inspection by 12/01/25.
findings.citation_text: 2-103.11(P) Person In Charge. The PERSON IN CHARGE shall ensure that: (P) FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with LAW, to the PERSON IN CHARGE, information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD, as specified under 2-201.11(A). [Pf]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: FIRST REPEAT: Inspector observed the grate of the pizza oven to contain a heavy accumulation of grease and food debris. CORRECTED- the PIC removed the grate to be cleaned and sanitized. Ensure all equipment is cleaned at a frequency to prevent the accumulation of debris, which may contaminate ready to eat (RTE) foods.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.12 Cooking and Baking Equipment. (A) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking and baking EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours. (B) The cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours by using the manufacturer's recommended cleaning procedure. [P]

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored and used.
findings.comment: Inspector observed a bottle containing red liquid to bear no label. CORRECTED- the liquid was identified as quaternary ammonia sanitizer, and the bottle was labeled accordingly. Ensure all containers holding chemicals are labeled once removed from their original container.
findings.citation_text: 7-101.11 Identifying Information, Prominence. Containers of POISONOUS OR TOXIC MATERIALS and PERSONAL CARE ITEMS shall bear a legible manufacturer's label. [Pf]

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment: FIRST REPEAT: Inspector observed a large hole on top of the beer cooler. This hole may allow for the accumulation of soil debris. Fill hole so that nonfood contact surfaces are smooth and easily cleanable.
findings.citation_text: 4-101.19 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other FOOD soiling or that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a CORROSION-RESISTANT, nonabsorbent, and SMOOTH material. [C]

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: The facility’s Chlorine bleach test strips were soiled and unable to be used to test sanitizer concentration. The facility also has quaternary ammonia to sanitize food contact surfaces, but no corresponding test strips. CORRECTED- quat test strips were acquired. Ensure the facility always has test strips available that correspond with the sanitizer being used for food contact surfaces at the facility to ensure proper sanitizing concentrations are being reached according to the manufacturer's label.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14 Sanitizing Solutions, Testing Devices. A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. [Pf]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Inspector observed an accumulation of soil debris on the lid of the chest freezer. Ensure all nonfood contact surfaces are cleaned at a frequency to prevent the accumulation of debris- which may contaminate RTE foods.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris. [C]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed grate of pizza oven in kitchen to be soiled with food debris. Clean and sanitize pizza oven grate. 

4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed interior cavity of microwave in service area to heavily soiled with food splash. Clean and sanitize interior of microwave. 

4-602.12: (A) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking and baking EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours. This section does not apply to hot oil cooking and filtering EQUIPMENT if it is cleaned as specified in Subparagraph 4-602.11(D)(6). (B) The cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours by using the manufacturer's recommended cleaning procedure.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
Observed duct tape covering holes on top of beer cooler. Remove duct tape, and fill holes so that surface is smooth and easily cleanable. 

4-101.19: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other FOOD soiling or that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a CORROSION-RESISTANT, nonabsorbent, and SMOOTH material.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed wet mop head to be stored head down on floor. Store mop in a way that promotes drying.

6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed buildup of soda syrup on floor under ice chest at bar. Clean floor under ice chest to remove soda syrup. 

6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed wet mop head to be stored head down in mop bucket. Store mop in a way that promotes drying.

6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. 
The drip tray of the pizza oven is soiled with crumbs and baked on cheese. Clean the oven at the end of each night. Management states that the pizza oven is mainly used on weekends. It is important to make sure that oven is cleaned so that it does not provide a food source for pests.
